title: data-profile corpus index
description: Machine-readable manifest of the data-profile cases, so a runner in any language consumes the corpus without parsing prose.

spec.description: The normative document this corpus is the executable form of.

file.description: Case path relative to this directory. No path separators in the filename, so an entry cannot reach outside the corpus.

section.description: The specification section this case pins. Subsection-capable, because data-profile.md has six real subsections (§1.1, §2.1, §3.1, §3.2, §6.1, §7.1) a chapter-only pattern could not name.
